cards.subject: The quilboar capital
lines: Crafted out of the same mighty vines as the Kraul, and the traditional capital of the whole quilboar race.
A lich lives in it now.

cards.subject: The door is a mouth
lines: The way in is made from the boar god's maw. You walk in through his teeth.
The outer dome's entry is an arched gap, nearly invisible to anyone who did not already know where to look.

cards.subject: Whose dungeon this is
lines: His idle lines give the whole occupation away: "We will enslave the quilboar!" and "Soon, the Scourge will rule the world!"
This is not a quilboar dungeon with undead in it.
It is an undead dungeon with quilboar livestock.

cards.subject: They were not raised. They agreed.
lines: The vanilla quest text is a Scourge ambassador's offer: the Barrens and the lands beyond, and "we simply want your aid in return."
Later lore overwrote this and had the lich simply raise them from corpses.
In here, they negotiated.

cards.subject: Ambassador Malcin
lines: The letter closes: "I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being."
He is out there.
You can go and settle it.

cards.subject: Tuten'kash
lines: A crypt fiend, and the name is Tutankhamun with a boar-dungeon accent.
His signature debuff is called Curse of Tuten'kash.
The joke got its own spell.

cards.subject: X'caliboar
lines: A rare elite quilboar just past Glutton, and a caster — dominate mind, shadow bolt.
He carries a two-hander called X'caliboar.
Somebody at Blizzard in 2004 was very pleased with themselves.

cards.subject: Glutton is getting hungry
lines: An abomination patrolling the lower tier of the Spiral, and he frenzies over and over.
The emote is the warning and it is the only one you get.
He got that way eating the dungeon's own spoiled dead.

cards.subject: Mordresh is dancing
cards.tag: Go and look at his pose
lines: He stands on a heap of skulls and bones in a dancing pose, with non-elite skeletons milling below him.
In life he was an orc shaman sent from Orgrimmar to find out what was happening here.
He was killed and raised, and refilled with fel instead of elements.

cards.subject: The idol is an oven
lines: It is not an altar. The quest text calls it a macabre oven, where the quilboar cook and eat the people they abduct out of the Barrens.
That is what the ritual puts out.
Not a curse. A kitchen.

cards.subject: Belnistrasz
cards.tag: He walks in as a human
lines: Only at the end does the reveal come. The image of a great-winged dragon fills your mind, and a more gravelled version of his voice speaks straight to you.
"Indeed mortals, you are the heroes I had hoped you would be."

cards.subject: Five minutes, seven waves
lines: "Okay, here we go. It's going to take about five minutes to shut this thing down through the ritual."
Killing everything is not the job. Keeping him upright is.
Plaguemaw the Rotting only exists at the end of it — skip the quest and he never spawns at all.

cards.subject: You do not actually kill him
lines: He sits on a mountain of spiked vines around a brazier burning with cold flame — the second brazier in this dungeon, and the one you cannot put out.
He has been put down repeatedly and keeps coming back. His phylactery was never destroyed.
"Too... Easy." He is technically correct about the whole arrangement.
